sources.entry: stats - free Mac system monitor for the menubar. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/exelban/stats)
Stats - macOS system monitor in your menu bar

summary.one_liner: Stats is a free, open-source macOS system monitor that shows CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network, battery, sensor and other readings in the menu bar.
summary.what_it_does: The app displays live system metrics as menu bar icons and widgets, covering CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network, battery, Bluetooth devices, and sensor data (temperature, voltage, power). It includes a multiple time zone clock. Individual modules can be turned off to reduce CPU and energy use, since the README names Sensors and Bluetooth as the most expensive. A fan control feature exists but is in legacy mode and no longer maintained. The README also describes a headless SSH install script that sets up the Remote module and links the machine to a "System Stats" account, and a macOS widgets option for desktop widgets. It collects no telemetry, but makes update-check and public IP requests to the author's servers.
use_cases: monitor CPU and memory usage from the menu bar
check Mac temperatures and fan-related sensor readings
watch network throughput and Wi-Fi network name
see battery level and Bluetooth device battery status
display multiple time zone clocks on a Mac
remotely monitor a Mac over SSH
how_to_run: Or download Stats.dmg from the latest release, open it and move Stats.app to the Applications folder
Headless: curl -fsSL <script URL from README> | bash (URL is missing from the README text)
stack: Swift (macOS app, inferred from the macOS-only app and Xcode-style build; not named in README)
notable: Menu bar monitor covering CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network, battery, sensors and Bluetooth in one app
Headless SSH install script that enables a Remote module and registers the app to launch at login
Modules can be disabled individually to lower CPU and energy impact
Localized into more than 40 languages, with thanks credited to contributors
Explicit privacy statement: no telemetry or analytics
caveats: Supports macOS 12 (Monterey) and newer, stable releases only; beta macOS is not supported
Fan control is legacy, not maintained, and receives no updates
Single maintainer; unsolicited pull requests are generally not accepted, so feature requests go through issues
keywords: check cpu load from menu bar
